parameters.pivots: confirmed_pivots left=3 right=3 over each contiguous real OHLC segment. Process only at available_date. If same center is both high and low, skip both as ambiguous; never infer intraday ordering.
parameters.cycle: Within same road ID, accept confirmed high whose center and confirmation are in that road; later same-kind high replaces pending with most recent, never highest hindsight. First subsequent confirmed low (center strictly after pending high and previous completed low; center and confirmation same road) consumes pending high and completes one cycle. Later lows without a new high are retained as no-new-cycle. New high center must be strictly after last completed low center. Road end/missing resets pending and previous cycle. Never rewrite completed events.
parameters.level: For every bar from high center through low center inclusive, require strictly ordered SMA20>60>120 AND EMA20>60>120; unordered day makes whole cycle incomparable, but retain it and it becomes previous cycle so cannot skip to an older convenient cycle. At ordered bar, depth rank=4 if low<min(SMA20,EMA20,SMA60,EMA60,SMA120,EMA120), else3 if low<=max(SMA120,EMA120), else2 if <=max60, else1 if <=max20, else0. Cycle level=max ranks over that causal observed interval. No ATR tolerance. Include touch equality, every level including0; strict equality to minimum six lines is touch, not below-all. Preserve per-day touch and below-group flags as identity evidence.
parameters.event: Signal only on low confirmation close when current AND immediately previous completed cycles are comparable and same road. Both cycles are already observed by t. X=previous_level-current_level, positive shallower; zero and negative retained. All scheduled daily rows retained with reason for non-event, no pair, unordered, missing.
